search.go:270-330: the chunk join reuses f.where and the v.model filter and keeps a score only when the vector length matches the query vector; archived and filtered memories are excluded exactly as chunk 0 is.

save.go:364-389: update() deletes the vectors row inside the edit transaction; vector_chunks has on delete cascade and store.go:29 sets foreign_keys(1) on every pooled connection, so a failed re-embed after an edit leaves neither a stale chunk 0 nor stale chunks.
putVectors: chunk 0 upsert, chunk delete and chunk inserts share one transaction, so a memory never mixes vectors of two texts; a failure part-way rolls back.

EmbedPending: all vectors are computed before any write, so a failed embedder batch writes nothing; the backfill case passes base=nil and writes chunks 1..n; a concurrent delete of the vectors row makes the FK insert fail and roll back.
EmbedPending SQL parameter order (model, model, EmbedBodyRunes, limit) matches the placeholders.

Migration v4: create table if not exists, no change to existing rows, reversible by dropping the table and setting user_version to 3; the store test covers the upgrade from v3 with data and the cascade on vector and memory deletion.
Invalid UTF-8 case: the chunk-0 copy marks the memory done and does not loop; the reverse mismatch cannot miss a chunk.
Other vectors consumers (neighbours.go:33 and :39, vectors.go:203, accept.go:304) read chunk 0 only, with unchanged semantics.
Not a defect: EmbedMemories sends every chunk of a capture batch in one request; a failed request leaves the memories pending, recoverable through EmbedPending.
